ctxMarket: Attention is on Solana’s technical upgrades and the expanding role of institutional players in tokenized real-world assets. Headlines also focus on internal company moves at high-profile Solana projects.
ctxTalking:
• Pump.fun reportedly laid off staff just before a major PUMP token allocation
• Major institutions like BlackRock and J.P. Morgan are building tokenized real-world assets on Solana
• Solana mainnet increased block limits to 100M CUs, with several new software releases
ctxMatters:
Layoffs at Pump.fun highlight ongoing volatility in team structures at fast-growing Solana projects.  
Institutional adoption signals growing confidence in Solana’s infrastructure for real-world asset tokenization.  
The mainnet upgrade may improve network performance and support more complex applications.
ctxSignal:
Signal: Institutional engagement and mainnet upgrades reflect long-term infrastructure and adoption trends.
Noise: Speculation around the timing and motives of Pump.fun’s layoffs.
ctxGlossary:
CUs (Compute Units) — A measure of computational resources used per Solana block  
Tokenized real-world assets — Physical or financial assets represented as tokens on a blockchain
